maBlendshapeSyncAutoSetup.title: MA Blendshape Sync Auto Setup
maBlendshapeSyncAutoSetup.copy: A Unity editor tool that automates Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync setup. It compares source and target mesh blendshape names, finds matches automatically, and generates the required Blendshape Sync bindings for one or many targets.

cards.title: Best For
cards.body: Outfits, body meshes, face parts, and other meshes that need to mirror the same expression blendshapes across multiple targets.

cards.title: Modular Avatar Workflow
cards.body: Adds the Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync component to target objects and builds bindings from matching blendshape names.

cards.title: Batch Setup
cards.body: You can register multiple targets, preview the detected matches, and apply everything in one pass.

meta.body: Designed for Unity 2022.3+, Modular Avatar 1.14.3+, and NDMF. Both source and target objects should contain valid SkinnedMeshRenderer components.

image.alt: MA Blendshape Sync Auto Setup English UI screenshot
image.caption: The tool window lets you assign a source object, collect multiple targets, preview common blendshapes, and apply bindings from one place.

sections.title: Key Features
items: Automatically detects matching blendshape names between the source object and target objects.
Adds Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync components and generates common blendshape bindings automatically.
Supports multiple target objects in a single setup pass.
Supports drag and drop, multi-selection, and collecting child SkinnedMeshRenderer objects.
Provides a preview of detected common blendshapes before applying changes.
Filters duplicate objects automatically and integrates with Unity Undo.

sections.title: Requirements
items: Unity 2022.3 or newer
Modular Avatar 1.14.3 or newer
NDMF
A source object with a SkinnedMeshRenderer
One or more target objects with SkinnedMeshRenderer components

sections.title: Basic Usage
items: Open Iyan-Kim > Tools > Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync Auto Setup.
Assign the source object that provides the reference blendshapes.
Add one or more target objects through drag and drop or the add-target button.
Enable child-object collection if you want child SkinnedMeshRenderer objects included automatically.
Review the detected common blendshapes in the preview area.
Click the setup button to generate Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync bindings for all valid targets.

entries.title: Source Object
entries.body: The source object defines the reference blendshape names. The tool compares this SkinnedMeshRenderer with each target.

entries.title: Target Objects
entries.body: Targets receive the Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync component. Matching blendshapes are bound automatically.

entries.title: Include Child Objects
entries.body: Searches child objects of the dropped targets and automatically adds any child object with a SkinnedMeshRenderer.

entries.title: Detected Common Blendshapes
entries.body: Shows the blendshapes that exist on both source and target meshes. Only these entries become actual bindings.

entries.title: Apply Blendshape Sync
entries.body: Creates or updates the Modular Avatar Blendshape Sync setup on the target objects using the detected matches.

sections.title: Tips
items: Source and target blendshape names must match exactly for automatic detection to work.
This is especially useful for outfit or body meshes that share the same facial expression shapes.
If a target already has a Blendshape Sync component, the tool reuses it and rebuilds the binding list.
Child-object collection is useful when a single outfit root contains multiple internal SkinnedMeshRenderer objects.

entries.title: No common blendshapes are found
entries.body: Check that source and target meshes actually use the same blendshape names. Differences in case, spaces, prefixes, or suffixes will prevent matching.

entries.title: The setup button is disabled
entries.body: Make sure a source object is assigned, at least one valid target exists, and at least one common blendshape has been detected.

entries.title: The source object shows an error
entries.body: Confirm that the source object contains a valid SkinnedMeshRenderer and that its mesh is connected correctly.

entries.title: The result does not work as expected
entries.body: Verify that source and target objects live inside the same avatar hierarchy and that Modular Avatar plus NDMF are installed and processed correctly.
